response.sql: WITH station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_band_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_band_usage, station_count, station_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(station_count) FROM phase) AS station_fraction FROM phase
